name: Proposal follow-up
when: Four or five days after the proposal, if there’s no reply.
subject: Re: Your proposal from Fieldwise
preheader: Happy to change anything in it.

blocks.text: Checking whether you had a chance to look at the proposal.
If anything doesn’t fit, whether it’s budget, timing or scope, tell me and I’ll rework it. We can also start with just the {{smallest_piece}} and add the rest later.
